question: Does Claude Code native PowerShell still require host approval under permissionMode allow-edits after Vercel AI SDK current main added it to the public built-in tool catalog?

sources.name: Vercel AI SDK Claude Code harness catalog
sources.claim: The public harness catalog includes native PowerShell and classifies it as toolUseKind bash.

sources.name: Vercel AI SDK Claude Code bridge permission logic
sources.claim: The bridge permission-kind table omits PowerShell; unknown native tools fall back to edit; allow-edits requires approval only for bash-kind tools.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Bash is bash in both catalogs and requires approval in allow-edits.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: The model recognizes the intended negative-control path.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: PowerShell is bash in the public catalog but falls back to edit in the bridge and therefore does not require approval in allow-edits.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Current-main catalog and permission enforcement disagree at the PowerShell boundary.

stop_condition: Stop once the exact current-main source, Bash negative control, executable model, and one target-native approval test agree on the classification question.
